description: Bootstrap lifecycle (CF17). Every allowed transition of registry/state-machines.json appears at least once below; rejected cases cover the safety rules: READY only after SMOKE_TEST (CF16), re-verify after reboot or restart (CF15, CF18), no installation without a fresh consent bound to plan_id (CF13, CR-13).

sequences.name: windows-wsl-install-uac-and-reboot
sequences.note: TC43: UAC for the WSL step, reboot offered, resume re-probes and continues to READY

sequences.name: host-already-prepared
sequences.note: Engine and image present: empty plan, pull skipped, smoke test still mandatory

sequences.name: consent-for-image-pull-only
sequences.note: SEC-M1: the image pull is an action; a plan whose only action is the pull still goes through consent and INSTALLING (no install steps)

sequences.name: pull-without-consent-after-resume
sequences.note: SEC-M1: the zero-action shortcut PLAN_READY -> ENGINE_CHECK never leads to IMAGE_PULL (guard image_in_consented_plan, consent cleared by PROBING)

sequences.name: pull-with-consent-from-before-resume
sequences.note: CR-13: consent given before a restart is cleared by PROBING

sequences.name: restart-in-plan-ready-and-consent
sequences.note: SEC-M3: a restart in PLAN_READY or WAITING_FOR_CONSENT resumes in PROBING; the journal is not trusted to continue

sequences.name: uac-declined-then-restart
sequences.note: TC31: refusing UAC cancels without workarounds

sequences.name: virtualization-disabled-then-fixed
sequences.note: TC44: VIRTUALIZATION_DISABLED gives ACTION_REQUIRED; after the user fixes BIOS the host is probed again

sequences.name: config-change-after-ready
sequences.note: CF17: a runtime configuration change returns the profile to probing

sequences.name: plan-stale-at-apply
sequences.note: TC28: apply with a stale plan_id leads to a new plan

sequences.name: crash-during-install-resume
sequences.note: CF15/CF18: process or computer restart during INSTALLING; resume re-probes and the re-probed plan needs fresh consent (CR-13, user decision 2026-11-06)

sequences.name: restart-in-each-in-flight-state
sequences.note: Every in-flight state resumes through PROBING

sequences.name: resume-without-fresh-consent
sequences.note: CR-13: consent is never carried over after a resume

cases.note: CR-17: plan integrity lost while waiting for privileges
TC04: early ACTION_REQUIRED for an unusable data folder
CF16: READY only after the smoke test
CF13: no system change without consent
SEC-M1: consented plans run through INSTALLING; only zero-action plans skip to ENGINE_CHECK, from PLAN_READY
SEC-M1: the image pull is an action
